mostWorthwhile.text: Following filtering with recovery was most worthwhile: it showed why the kidneys take useful substances back rather than simply filtering out waste.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the ureters and bladder was clear but fairly straightforward and repetitive after following the fluid route.

surprise.text: The filter lets useful glucose, salts and water through along with waste; the recovery tube then returns useful substances to blood.

arbitrary.text: None felt arbitrary. The organ fittings had a clear purpose, although adding the bladder was the only offered combination at that point.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter: following the filter and recovery route made a familiar organ's job more understandable, though the straightforward fittings were less engaging.
